title: Critique: IIT is pseudoscience until its central claims are testable

statements.text: An open letter signed by over a hundred researchers argued that IIT's panpsychist implications (inactive grids of logic gates, early fetuses and organoids being conscious) are untestable, and that the label pseudoscience applies until the theory as a whole is empirically testable.

sources.quote: According to IIT, an inactive grid of connected logic gates that are not performing any useful computation can be conscious—possibly even more so than humans
IIT requires meaningful empirical tests before being heralded as a ‘leading’ or ‘well-established’ theory.
